title: CeraVe Hydrating Cream-to-Foam Cleanser — US
description: A cream-to-foam facial cleanser with ceramides and glycerin. The US ingredient list contains no listed fragrance or essential oils.
claim: CeraVe describes this exact cleanser as fragrance-free. Its published US ingredient list has no listed parfum or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the full US ingredient list, including its ceramides, surfactants and humectants; no essential oils are listed.
use: Rinse-off facial cleansing. Follow the current bottle directions.

title: CeraVe Renewing SA Cleanser — US
description: A salicylic-acid cleanser in CeraVe’s US range. Fragrance-free is not a guarantee that an exfoliating formula will suit sensitive skin.
claim: CeraVe identifies this US cleanser as fragrance-free. The complete published ingredient list has no listed parfum or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the US list containing salicylic acid, ceramides and corn oil; corn oil is a carrier oil, not an essential oil.
notes: Salicylic acid and other ingredients can still irritate. Do not confuse this with differently formulated regional cleansers.
use: An exfoliating rinse-off cleanser. Follow label directions and avoid known personal triggers.

title: Prequel Gleanser Non-Drying Glycerin Cleanser
description: The original face-and-body Gleanser with 50% glycerin—not the separate exfoliating variants.
claim: Prequel’s FAQ states that Gleanser is fragrance-free. Its full ingredient list contains no listed essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the original Gleanser list containing glycerin, aloe leaf juice and oat kernel flour, with no listed fragrance or essential oils.
notes: Contains oat and aloe ingredients. Fragrance-free does not rule out other ingredient allergies.
use: Rinse-off face and body cleansing, following the brand’s directions.

title: AESTURA ATOBARRIER365 Cream — US listing
description: A ceramide-containing moisturizer with a checked US Sephora listing. Compare the exact formula and current packaging.
claim: The specific manufacturer and US retailer ingredient lists show no parfum/fragrance or essential oils. The US listing also describes the cream as fragrance-free.
essentialOilEvidence: Compared the brand’s complete formula with the US Sephora ingredient list: neither lists essential oils or parfum.
notes: The pages also include a general clean-beauty callout allowing less than 1% synthetic fragrance. Our classification uses the specific ingredient lists, not that callout. Ask the brand if your pack differs.
use: A leave-on moisturizer. Follow the exact US pack directions.

title: COSRX The Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizer
description: A ceramide moisturizer whose published formula includes squalane, cholesterol and humectants, without listed fragrance or essential oils.
claim: The complete ingredient list on the official product page contains no listed parfum/fragrance or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the official complete Water/Aqua ingredient list, through its ceramide and hyaluronic-acid ingredients; no essential oils are listed.
use: A leave-on facial moisturizer. Follow current label instructions.

title: Sofie Pavitt Face Omega Rich Moisturizer
description: A rich facial moisturizer with squalane and fatty acids. Its jojoba, sunflower and argan oils are carrier oils, not essential oils.
claim: The brand describes Omega as fragrance-free. The full ingredients list contains no listed parfum or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the full list, including jojoba seed, sunflower seed and argan kernel carrier oils; no scented essential oils are listed.
use: A leave-on facial moisturizer. Follow the brand directions.

title: Farmacy Green Clean Cleansing Balm — Fragrance-Free
description: The specifically fragrance-free cleansing balm. The Original and Honey Vanilla versions are not included in this profile.
claim: Farmacy identifies this exact variant as fragrance-free. Its complete formula has no listed parfum or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the fragrance-free variant’s list: sunflower and moringa seed oils and botanical extracts are listed, but no essential oils or fragrance are listed.
notes: Plant extracts are not automatically essential oils or allergy-free. Choose Fragrance-Free on the brand page, which also links to scented variants.
use: A rinse-off makeup and sunscreen cleansing balm. Follow directions.

title: Vaseline Healing Jelly — Original, US
description: The Original US petroleum jelly, not cocoa-butter or other scented versions. The brand lists one ingredient: white petrolatum.
claim: The official US page describes Original Healing Jelly as fragrance-free and lists white petrolatum USP (100%).
essentialOilEvidence: The complete one-ingredient formula is white petrolatum USP (100%); no essential oils are listed.
use: A skin-protectant ointment. Follow US packaging instructions.

title: Aquaphor Healing Ointment — US
description: The US multi-purpose skin-protectant ointment. The manufacturer confirms fragrance-free; its essential-oil status has not been separately confirmed here.
claim: Aquaphor’s US page identifies this ointment as fragrance-free and lists petrolatum (41%) as the active ingredient.
notes: The accessible page did not expose the full inactive-ingredient list for a separate essential-oil review. Check the current Drug Facts label, including lanolin-related ingredients if relevant to your allergies.
use: Skin protection according to the current US Drug Facts label.

title: Kiss My Face Liquid Rock Roll-On — Fragrance Free
description: The exact Fragrance Free mineral-salt roll-on. Do not substitute its Lavender or Patchouli variants.
claim: The official page labels this exact roll-on Fragrance Free. Its full ingredient list has no listed essential oils or parfum.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the complete water/potassium alum formula with willow bark and lichen extracts; no essential oils are listed.
notes: The manufacturer page has inconsistent stock indicators. This is a US product source, not a promise that it is in stock. Contains potassium alum; do not assume an aluminum-free claim.
use: An underarm deodorant. Follow label directions.

title: Tubby Todd All Over Ointment — Fragrance-Free
description: The fragrance-free, 1% colloidal-oatmeal version. This profile excludes the Lavender + Rosemary formula.
claim: The brand separately publishes ingredients for Fragrance-Free and Lavender + Rosemary. The Fragrance-Free list contains no added fragrance or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed only the Fragrance-Free active and inactive lists. The separate Lavender + Rosemary formula contains fragrance and lavender oils and is not included.
notes: Contains oat, beeswax and botanical extracts. Do not replace prescribed eczema treatment based on a shopping article or this listing.
use: Follow the exact product’s Drug Facts and age-specific instructions.

title: Nécessaire The Body Lotion — Fragrance-Free
description: The fragrance-free body lotion with niacinamide and plant carrier oils. Carrier oils are different from scented essential oils.
claim: Nécessaire labels this lotion fragrance-free. The published full ingredients contain no listed parfum or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the full list with jojoba, marula and meadowfoam seed carrier oils, peptides and niacinamide; no essential oils are listed.
use: A leave-on body moisturizer. Follow current packaging instructions.

title: Nécessaire The Body Wash — Fragrance-Free
description: The Fragrance-Free body wash. Eucalyptus and other scented versions are not interchangeable with this one.
claim: The manufacturer labels this exact version Fragrance-Free. Its complete list contains no listed parfum or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the Fragrance-Free formula with surfactants, ceramides and marula seed oil; no essential oils are listed.
use: A rinse-off body wash. Follow the manufacturer’s directions.

title: Aveeno Therapeutic Shave Gel with Oat — US
description: A shave gel that the US manufacturer explicitly identifies as fragrance-free. Essential-oil status has not been separately confirmed here.
claim: The US product page states that this exact gel is formulated without fragrance. We do not extend that claim to every Aveeno shave product.
notes: The full list was not exposed in the accessible ingredient panel, so this is not included in the stricter no-essential-oils filter. Read the current can and aerosol warnings.
use: For shaving, according to can directions. Follow aerosol handling and storage warnings.

title: Cleure Original Unflavored Toothpaste
description: An unflavored, mint-free toothpaste. It is fluoride-free, so discuss your cavity-prevention needs with a dentist before switching.
claim: Cleure identifies this Original version as flavor-free and mint-free. Its complete published ingredient list has no listed fragrance or essential oils.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the Original formula listing water, glycerin, xanthan gum, sodium bicarbonate, calcium carbonate and xylitol hydroxypropylsulfonate, without mint or essential oils.
notes: Fluoride toothpaste has established cavity-prevention benefits. Do not assume fluoride-free toothpaste provides equivalent protection or that every mouth symptom is a fragrance allergy. Ask a dentist about suitable alternatives.
use: Toothbrushing according to current label and dentist advice.

title: Real Purity Roll-On Deodorant — Contains Essential Oils
description: An essential-oil-containing roll-on, shown only as a separately labelled scented alternative—not a fragrance-free recommendation.
claim: The official ingredients list includes grapefruit, sandalwood, lavender, rosemary, geranium, sage and rosewood oils. It does not list a separate parfum/fragrance mixture. This formula is not fragrance-free.
essentialOilEvidence: Reviewed the full brand list, which explicitly names several essential oils. No separate parfum/fragrance mixture is listed; this does not prove every ingredient’s natural or synthetic origin.
warning: Contains scented essential oils. Not fragrance-free, not scent-free and not suitable for an essential-oil avoidance routine. Natural scent can also cause allergy or irritation.
notes: A shopping article’s description of a product as unscented does not override its ingredients. Do not interpret essential oils as a safer or allergy-free substitute.
use: An underarm deodorant. Follow current directions and avoid ingredients that trigger you.
